_README: Machine-readable form of docs/notes/round-66-e2e-verify.md.
Read by tools/e2e_checklist.ps1.
WHY THIS FILE IS JSON AND NOT MARKDOWN:
The markdown checklist is for humans. A runner that parses markdown is a
parser waiting to silently skip a line -- and a silently skipped check is
indistinguishable from a passing one. Structured input means 'unknown key'
can be a hard error instead of a heading the regex missed.
EVERY ITEM MUST DECLARE mode:
auto   -- has at least one machine check; runs unattended.
manual -- no machine check exists yet. The runner PRINTS 'MANUAL: ...' and
still counts as a pass (per the brief), but the reason must be
concrete. 'hard to test' is not a reason; 'no entry point exists'
is.
A check that silently does nothing is forbidden. If you cannot automate it,
say manual and say why.
CHECK TYPES (all must pass for an auto item):
screenshot -- verify_shots-style content check on a PNG
log        -- regex count over the client stdout / rust stderr
file       -- filesystem assertion (exists / absent / json key / size)
tests      -- `flutter test <files>` must report +N -0
source     -- literal or regex presence/absence in a source file
SEVERITY: 'blocking' contributes to the exit code; 'info' only prints.

items.title: R2 failure headline no longer claims the built-in proxy is down
items.trigger: classify() on the real log line, exercised via flutter test
items.manual_note: Real-device reproduction needs a playing stream; not reachable in an isolated data dir.

items.title: R2 attribution reads raw text, not the display-rewritten text
items.trigger: source assertion on the three text variables + call-site count

checks.why: that literal can never appear in the raw text -- it was a dead predicate

items.title: Danmaku proxy three-state: four committed gate files still green
items.trigger: flutter test the four committed files

items.title: Danmaku proxy UI: the three options are in the REAL product page
items.trigger: flutter test the page-render gate added by verify-e2e
items.manual_note: Renders the real DanmakuSourcePage via flutter_test; produces .probe/e2e/danmaku-proxy-*.png.

items.title: Danmaku proxy: direct must be explicit DIRECT (never null)
items.trigger: source assertion -- null would make Dart read HTTPS_PROXY

items.title: Danmaku proxy: socks5 addresses are explicitly refused
items.trigger: source assertion on the scheme guard

items.title: Tab screenshots exist, are non-empty, right size, distinct, not a modal
items.manual_note: Requires the Release bundle to exist. Run e2e_shots.ps1 first to (re)generate the images.

items.title: Screenshot verifier itself has discriminative power
items.trigger: verify_shots.ps1 on a dir whose settings.png IS the modal

checks.why: This is a negative control: the runner must reproduce exit 1 here.

items.manual_note: Fixture .probe/e2e-modal6 is built from the real incident image; see docs/notes/round-66-e2e-verify.md.

items.title: R5 live: play controls must not overlap the line chips
items.manual_note: Needs a live stream playing. Judgement is Rect intersection (area must be 0) taken from the running app, which needs either a reachable live page or a running probe. Not automatable from the tab-screenshot pipeline because the player page is not a bottom-bar tab.

items.title: R5 player controls are not clipped by the window
items.manual_note: Same blocker as R5-1: requires the player page. Task C of this round measured the mute icon visible ratio separately; see docs/notes/round-66-e2e-verify.md.

items.title: R6 live quality/line classification
items.manual_note: Requires a live stream whose upstream exposes several qualities. No fixture exists; an isolated data dir has zero providers.

items.title: R1 danmaku chip has no fringe/halo at its edge
items.manual_note: Needs the player page with the danmaku panel open. The tab pipeline cannot reach it. Pixel criterion is documented (ring of alpha 1..254 around the chip).

items.title: R8 cache page: whole-drama delete affordance is visible
items.manual_note: Needs at least one downloaded item. An isolated data dir has none, so the delete affordance does not render. Criterion: hit-rect >= 24x24 fully inside the cover, contrast >= 3:1.

items.title: R3 danmaku settings dialog: sub-items visible and searchable
items.manual_note: Dialog only opens from the player page. NOTE for whoever automates it later: this page uses a lazily-built CustomScrollView -- call tester.scrollUntilVisible / ensureVisible BEFORE asserting 'not found'.

items.title: R3-4 dialog must not pass click events through to the player
items.trigger: flutter test the commited no-passthrough gate
items.manual_note: Real-device click-through still needs a human; the widget gate proves the guard is wired.

items.title: CS-1 backup export reports whether credentials were included
items.trigger: source assertion: the 'not included' note must exist

checks.why: the panel MUST say so; silence makes the user think everything was backed up

items.title: CS-1 sync panel: switch on without a passphrase must say 'not synced'
items.trigger: source assertion on the two distinguishable status strings
items.manual_note: The two 'not synced' states (no passphrase vs no credentials) must stay textually distinct; assert the reason, not just the verdict.

items.title: Skip-marker write failures are visible (not silently swallowed)
Skip-marker read timeout cannot spin forever
The client logs no Unhandled Exception during an isolated start
The update dialog did not appear during the isolated run
items.manual_note: This is the cheap half of the false-green guard; the pixel side is SHOT-1/SHOT-2.

items.title: The isolated run never wrote the real data directory
items.manual_note: e2e_shots.ps1 compares the isolated dir against %APPDATA%\app.sourin.player and refuses to run if they overlap, and it prints the real path as 'NOT touched'. Proving the real dir was not MODIFIED would need a pre/post hash of the whole tree; not implemented, so this stays manual. Do not silently mark it verified.
